sloka: जिज्ञासुः स तु बाहूनां सहस्रस्योत्तमं बलम् ।रुरोध नर्मदावेगं बाहुभिर्बहुभिर्वृतः ।। ७.३२.४ ॥
transliteration: jijñāsuḥ sa tu bāhūnāṁ sahasrasyottamaṁ balam ।rurodha narmadāvegaṁ bāhubhirbahubhirvṛtaḥ ।। 7.32.4 ॥

translations.english: Desirous of testing the supreme strength of his thousand arms, he indeed obstructed the flow of the Narmada river with his many arms.
